text: Cheryl Blackman, Interim General Manager, Economic Development and Culture, will present an update on preliminary work and next steps regarding the protection of Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Queer and Two-Spirit businesses and cultural spaces in the Church and Wellesley Village. This presentation is a first step in response to Council's Request in Item MM14.8 - Protecting LGBTQ2S+ Small Businesses and Cultural Space - to conduct a review of existing City of Toronto programs and include recommendations that can further enhance optimal conditions for LGBTQ2S+ small businesses and cultural spaces to succeed and thrive.
The Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Queer and Two-Spirit Advisory Committee received the item for information.
